en: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Liangjie of Dongshan in Ruizhou,
compiled by the Śramaṇa Yufeng of Mount Jing,
Yuanshen (the master of the groundless ground), and Guo Ningzhi.
The Master’s name was Liangjie;
he was the son of the Yu family of Kuaiji.
In his early years...
While reciting the Heart Sutra under his teacher,
he reached the passage, "There is no eye, ear, nose, tongue, body,
or mind," when he suddenly felt his face with his hand.
He asked the Master, saying,
"I possess eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and so forth;
why does the sutra say they do not exist?"
His teacher was startled and marveled at this, saying,
"I am not your teacher.
He then pointed him toward Mount Wuxie to pay respects to Chan Master Mo and receive the tonsure.

wondrously in harmony with the great propagation [of the Dharma].

furthermore, attained Cao Shan’s profound realization of the essential meaning.
Excellently singing forth sublime counsel,
the Way unites sovereign and minister;
the biased and the correct interpenetrate one another.

the profound and sublime tradition of Dongshan spread throughout the world.
